name: ando
description: Connect Ando to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Ando MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Ando to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with team chat with agents using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Ando workspace.
Find anything in Ando that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review team chat with agents in Ando.
